items.title: Cisco Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Year It Already Guided
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) trades near $106 a share, about 24.6 times the $4.33 of non-GAAP earnings per share it reported for fiscal 2026. That is the same basis Cisco uses for its guidance and analysts use for their forecasts. For a networking supplier with $63.33 billion of revenue behind it, that is rich. And it ignores the two years analysts have already forecast.

items.title: Why Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) jumped 3% in the afternoon session after the launch of its Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense, an agentic offensive security service designed to perpetually find and fix enterprise exposures.

items.title: Trump Downplayed AI Safety Concerns, but His Investment Portfolio Bought Cybersecurity Stocks
items.summary: President Donald Trump has called artificial-intelligence safety fears a “hoax.”  The president’s latest financial disclosure for July shows his portfolio bought stocks of cybersecurity companies, which address the growing need for protection as AI keeps developing.  Both the White House and the Trump Organization said Trump’s stock and bond portfolio is independently managed by third-party financial institutions.
